items.title: We’re launching Humanity’s First Exam and a Kaggle hackathon to test LLM reliability.
items.content: Google launches Humanity’s First Exam to test LLM reliability across 544 prompts.
items.contentSnippet: Google launches Humanity’s First Exam to test LLM reliability across 544 prompts.

summaries.zh: 谷歌推出人类首次考试，通过544个提示测试大语言模型的可靠性，并同步举办Kaggle黑客马拉松活动。此举旨在评估LLM在不同场景下的表现，推动技术发展。
summaries.en: Google is launching Humanity's First Exam, a comprehensive assessment using 544 prompts to evaluate the reliability of large language models (LLMs). The initiative also includes a Kaggle hackathon to further test and improve LLM performance. The exam aims to measure how well AI systems understand and respond to diverse human scenarios. This project represents a significant step in assessing and advancing the capabilities of LLMs.

items.title: Walter Isaacson on curiosity and creativity in the AI age.
items.content: Walter Isaacson joins Google to discuss how history’s greatest innovators inspire creativity and human judgment in the AI age. Watch the episode.
items.contentSnippet: Walter Isaacson joins Google to discuss how history’s greatest innovators inspire creativity and human judgment in the AI age. Watch the episode.

summaries.zh: 瓦尔特·艾萨克森在谷歌探讨了历史上伟大创新者如何启发人工智能时代的创造力和人类判断力。他强调了好奇心在创新中的重要性，并分析了AI与人类智慧的协同关系。艾萨克森认为，历史中的创新者通过不断探索和质疑，推动了科技进步。他呼吁在AI时代保持好奇心，以激发创造力。
summaries.en: Walter Isaacson discusses the role of curiosity and creativity in the AI era during his talk at Google. He explores how historical innovators can inspire creativity and human judgment alongside artificial intelligence. The event includes a video of the discussion.
